Mapping/labels: https://www.inegi.org.mx/contenidos/programas/ensu/datosabiertos/conjunto_de_datos_ensu_2025_1t_csv.zip (sha256 e6287ebe0d900118053909a48bd365c4064aa92a930a9c4278526371396b6686, fetched 2026-09-28), conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0325/diccionario_de_datos/diccionario_de_datos_ensu_cb_0325.csv (variable labels), catalogos/bp2_*.csv (value labels) and conjunto_de_datos/conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0325.csv (raw data, sha256 fe9f1dacf22bb3131096a67e1355fccbf39fd64222ce0c98e414e76bffd37b7b).
note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #2, Q1 2025 Conflicts) keeps INEGI columns bp2_1..bp2_4_11 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0325.csv (imported lowercased) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); recodes: bp2_1 9 -> missing, bp2_3_* 9 -> missing, id = row number within the 2025 Q1 subset. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's own 2025 Q1 data dictionary labels each BP2_* column (e.g. BP2_2_16 'Conflictos o enfrentamientos: Grafiti o pintas a su casa por alguien que usted identifique'; BP2_3_4 'Incidentes o problemas con desconocidos(as) en la calle'; BP2_4_09 'Tipo de consecuencias derivadas de conflictos: Dialogo/platica'); 37/37 labels agree in content with the 2025 Q1 questionnaire option carrying the same code number. 2025 Q1 vs 2024 Q4 source check (done, not assumed): same 37 BP2_* variables; the only dictionary label change is BP2_2_17 'Otra situacion' -> 'Otro' (now matches the print); all 37 catalogos/bp2_*.csv byte-identical to Q4 2024's. Questionnaire Section II: CP2 introduction is the Q3/Q4 2024 wording ('Las situaciones conflictivas pueden ser parte de nuestra vida cotidiana...'); 2.1, 2.3, 2.4 stems and all 18+7+11 options are identical to Q4 2024; the 2.2 stem again prints the typo 'familares' (sic) -- as in 2024 Q1/Q2, corrected in 2024 Q3/Q4 -- confirmed on an 80-dpi render of p.3 and shipped as printed. All 38 distinct Spanish strings shipped (CP2 intro, 3 section stems, 34 distinct item texts) are found in the 2025 Q1 text layer after whitespace/dot-leader normalisation, apart from bp2_2_12 whose print wraps 'producto/' + 'servicio' across a line (joined without a space, as the siblings did). Text layer carries the bold stems (checked against the render). Cross-check (route 9 style): all 74 live item x level counts (queried server-side, no export) equal the raw INEGI 2025 Q1 CSV after the .do's recodes, 74/74 (e.g. bp2_1 1/2 = 9699/13877, bp2_2_18 0/1 = 7861/1838, bp2_2_16 0/1 = 9159/540, bp2_4_09 0/1 = 3464/4397); raw has 23591 rows, 15 bp2_1=9 set missing -> 23576 live ids; 19 respondents with bp2_3_*=9 on all 7 bp2_3 items set missing (bp2_3 n = 7842 vs bp2_4 n = 7861). Words: item_text / section_prompt / instructions are the administered questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials), not the terser dictionary labels. Kept as printed: '(as)' gender fills, 'familares' (sic), trailing '?' on 2.2 options and the stem's trailing ellipsis. Normalised: line wraps joined. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blanks after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'B' Y CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO / LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; PASE A LA SECCION III; SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 18 'NINGUNO', PASE A LA SECCION III). Structure (same as batch_672/676/680/685): section _1 = 2.1 screener (stem in item_text), _2 = 2.2 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _3 = 2.3, _4 = 2.4; instructions = CP2 read-aloud introduction. Options: bp2_1 1=Si, 2=No (questionnaire and catalogo; 9 'No sabe / no responde' set missing by the .do, no row). The 36 checklist items are 0/1 flags; option_text is INEGI's catalogo value label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si'), not questionnaire print. Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Routing (not a defect): 2.2 asked only if 2.1=Si (n=9699 = bp2_1 Si count); 2.3/2.4 skipped when 2.2 code 18 'Ninguno' was circled (7861 = 9699 - 1838). Step 3b: live items match this question block exactly (37 = 1 + 18 + 7 + 11); dictionary Description ('Q1 2025') is accurate, but the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q1 (marzo 2025, file suffix 0325) wave -- same defect as the 2024 siblings. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), reused verbatim from batch_685 for every field (the 'familares' typo does not change the English, which matches batch_672's rendering of the same typo'd stem); nothing translated fresh. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire. Rights: instrument_rights_register.csv INEGI row verdict=ship (Ben 2026-09-23, irw#2381 R01; INEGI Terminos de libre uso, attribution only), applied not re-derived; credit condition applied in public_note.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2025, primer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section II (questions 2.1-2.4) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
